title: Susmita Nursery
subtitle: Next-Gen Botanical E-Commerce Platform with Interactive 3D Desk Plant Previews
summary: A high-end e-commerce botanical platform engineered for Susmita Nursery. Features an expansive indoor plant catalog, interactive 3D desktop plant preview models, localized delivery calculators, and frictionless mobile order drawers.
challenge: Susmita Nursery needed to transition from traditional local nursery sales to a nationwide digital e-commerce presence capable of showcasing indoor desktop plants effectively.
Traditional 2D static images failed to convey real plant dimensions, foliage texture, and desk placement scale, leading to high cart abandonment and customer uncertainty.
solution: We engineered a high-performance Next.js botanical e-commerce platform integrated with interactive 3D plant visualizers, allowing customers to preview indoor desk plants in real-time.
Implemented a lightning-fast catalog search, automated inventory management via Supabase, and a streamlined mobile checkout flow with external seller links and direct WhatsApp order drawers.
results: Achieved a 180% surge in online order conversions within the first 60 days of platform launch.
Increased user time-on-site by 4.2x driven by interactive 3D desktop plant preview features.
Reduced cart abandonment rates significantly through frictionless mobile navigation drawers and instant order triggers.
